name: startup-ignition-toolsuite-official
description: Validate startup ideas with the Startup Ignition method: read your ToolSuite ideas, run the validation steps, ask the mentor, and edit canvases and assumptions.

interface.longDescription: Startup Ignition ToolSuite is a startup idea validation platform. It guides founders through the Startup Ignition method: Idea Analysis, Big Idea Canvas, customer personas, explainer-video tests with real or simulated customers, business model canvas, riskiest assumptions, interview scripts and interview analysis. This plugin brings that work into ChatGPT. Ask what your idea's score is and why; have the assumptions or interview scripts drafted; ask the Startup Ignition AI mentor a question about your idea; get the business model canvas as a picture; export a PDF. You choose the workspaces, the permissions and a daily usage limit when you connect. Participants' names and contact details on file are left out of what the assistant reads from your interviews. Requires a Startup Ignition ToolSuite account.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my idea in ToolSuite and what to do next.
Identify the riskiest assumptions behind my idea and draft the interview scripts.
Show me my business model canvas as a picture.

positive.description: Overview of a saved idea, with the recommended next step
positive.prompt: Give me an overview of my FieldNote idea in ToolSuite and tell me what to do next.
positive.expected_behavior: The reply gives FieldNote's idea strength score (7), says 6 of 12 validation steps have been created (Idea Analysis, Big Idea Canvas, Business Model Canvas, Identify Assumptions, Draft Interview Scripts, AI Interview Setup) and names Deep Secondary Market Research as the next step. Nothing changes and no credits are spent.

positive.description: Read the riskiest assumptions and the personas they concern
positive.prompt: What are the riskiest assumptions behind FreshTable, and which personas do they concern?
positive.expected_behavior: The stored assumptions with their risk and impact placement, all still untested hypotheses, linked to the two personas (Market-Garden Farmer, Chef-Owner of a Farm-to-Table Restaurant). Content matches the Identify Assumptions page in the ToolSuite app. Nothing changes and no credits are spent.

positive.description: Ask the Startup Ignition mentor about a specific idea
positive.prompt: Ask the Startup Ignition mentor which persona I should interview first for FieldNote and why.
positive.expected_behavior: A written answer from the mentor that refers to FieldNote's own personas (Owner-Operator Technician, Service Manager at a 12-Truck Shop), not generic advice. A few credits are charged and the tool result says how many.

positive.description: Edit an idea, then undo the edit
positive.prompt: Add an assumption to FieldNote: "Technicians will record a voice summary before leaving the driveway." Then show me the edit history and undo it.
positive.expected_behavior: The assumption is added, appears in the AI edit history, and is removed by the undo. The assumptions page in the app shows the same before and after. No credits are spent.

positive.description: Export a page as a PDF
positive.prompt: Export the interview scripts for FreshTable as a PDF and give me the link.
positive.tools_triggered: list_ideas, export_pdf, and get_run_status if the PDF is still rendering
positive.expected_behavior: A download link to a PDF laid out like the Draft Interview Scripts page in ToolSuite, with scripts for both personas. The link works for up to one hour. The idea is not changed and no credits are spent.

negative.description: "Interview" overlaps with the plugin's customer-interview tools, but this is job interview prep for an individual, not startup work. The model should answer directly.
negative.prompt: I have a job interview at a hospital tomorrow for a nursing position. Help me prepare answers to common questions.

negative.description: "Ideas" overlaps with the plugin's idea tools, but this is personal planning with no startup or ToolSuite context. The model should brainstorm on its own.
negative.prompt: Give me some ideas for my daughter's eighth birthday party.

negative.description: "Persona" here is a tabletop game character, not a customer persona. No startup or business context; the model answers directly.
negative.prompt: Help me write a backstory for my new Dungeons & Dragons persona, a halfling rogue.

review.commerce_description: This plugin sells nothing and takes no payment, and it has no tool for buying credits. Some tools spend credits the user already holds in their ToolSuite account, within a daily limit the user sets when connecting.

publication.release_notes: First public release: read your ToolSuite ideas, run validation steps, ask the AI mentor and edit your work from ChatGPT, with the permissions and daily credit limit you choose. This version sets every tool's safety hints and description from its actual behavior.
